news.title: MacKinnon has 2 goals and a rare fight in the Avs' 8-4 victory over the Kings in opener
news.ruTitle: У Маккиннона 2 гола и редкая борьба в победе «Авс» над «Кингз» со счетом 8–4 в первом матче.
news.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored twice in a four-goal second period and capped his night with a rare fight, and the Colorado Avalanche opened the season with an 8-4 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Wednesday night.

news.title: Maple Leafs beat the Islanders 2-1 to rebound from opening loss
news.ruTitle: «Мэйпл Лифс» обыграли «Айлендерс» со счетом 2:1 и отыгрались после первого поражения
news.description: — Easton Cowan had a goal and an assist in the first period and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the New York Islanders 2-1 on Wednesday night for their first victory under coach Jim Hiller.

news.title: Malkin scores, Silovs stops 19 shots as Penguins pile on in 7-0 win over Flyers in teams' opener
news.ruTitle: Малкин забивает, Силов отбивает 19 бросков, а "Пингвинз" набирают обороты в победе над "Флайерз" со счетом 7:0 в первом матче команды
news.description: — Evgeni Malkin, Hendrix Lapierre and Filip Hallander scored in the second period and Arturs Silovs stopped 19 shots to help the Pittsburgh Penguins steamroll the Philadelphia Flyers 7-0 on Wednesday night.

news.title: Golden Knights sign C William Karlsson to 2-year, $13.5M deal

news.title: Stars sign backup goalie DeSmith to 2-year, $5M extension
news.ruTitle: «Звезды» подписали резервного вратаря ДеСмита с продлением на 2 года и 5 миллионов долларов
news.description: The Stars signed backup goaltender Casey DeSmith to a two-year, $5 million contract extension that runs through the 2028-29 season.

news.title: Avalanche signing coach Jared Bednar to four-year extension
